text.p: These are the leading stories in the Ugandan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A United Nations report says Ugandan women have the highest fertility rate in Africa.
- Uganda Airlines is to recruit five new pilots and retrain them at a cost of more than 100 million Ugandan shillings in Ireland and Zimbabwe amid claims of victimisation by airline workers.
- Members accuse government of delay tactics in releasing money to facilitate medical bills for deceased legislator Daudi Magezi.
- The Commander of the Uganda People's (UPA) group which indicated on Monday that it had resumed rebel activities is to meet a powerful minister in the Kenyan government this week.

- Outgoing United States of America ambassador to Uganda Michael Southwick says that although President Yoweri Museveni has done well in government, he is presiding over an undemocratic system which cannot reform.
